QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_56

question.text: Bhaskar Yield Fund has called-up capital INR 100 crore and hurdle rate 8% p.a. What is the Reference Hurdle NAV at end of Year 1?

explanation.text: The Logic: Reference Hurdle Y1 = Called-up × (1 + hurdle) = 100 × 1.08 = INR 108 crore. The Trap: Option B is principal only. Option C subtracts. Option D is Y2 compounded. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B tests Reference Hurdle; XIX-C requires yearly waterfall accrual. Manager's Pro-Tip: For annual incentive-fee crystallisation, NAV must exceed Reference Hurdle AND HWM (higher of). Automate the comparison in your NAV reporting system — manual tracking causes errors.
